basis: Taiwan Input-Output tables are compiled on the basis of the System of National Accounts 2008. Evidence: "2016 Input-Output statistics are based on the System of National Accounts 2008, as well as the strict change of ownership principle according to the 6th edition of Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual (BPM6)."

Input-Output statistics apply the strict change-of-ownership principle of BPM6 for goods for processing and related trade flows. Evidence: "2016 Input-Output statistics are based on the System of National Accounts 2008, as well as the strict change of ownership principle according to the 6th edition of Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual (BPM6)."

Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) compiles Balance of Payments statistics in accordance with BPM6 (implemented from 2016, with historical series converted). Evidence: "Beginning 2016, Taiwan’s BOP is compiled in accordance with "the Sixth Edition of Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual (BPM6).""

Private final consumption expenditure and other components in the national accounts are deflated using detailed consumer price indices compiled by DGBAS. Evidence: "Items of Deflators ... Private final consumption expenditure ... Consumer price indices of food, non-alcoholic beverages ... Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics"

Customs-based merchandise trade statistics classify commodities according to the Harmonized System (HS) via the Customs Import Tariff and Import and Export Commodity Classification of the Republic of China. Evidence: "Goods are classified according to the Customs Import Tariff and Import and Export Commodity Classification of the Republic of China."

Producer Price Index weights for domestic manufacturers draw on Industrial Production Statistics (alongside National Accounts and association data). Evidence: "For manufacturer, in 2024, Industrial Production Statistics, National Accounts Statistics and data provided by relative associations are referred for weighting."

PPI weights incorporate National Accounts Statistics; PPI itself is used as a reference for GDP and Input-Output Tables. Evidence: "For manufacturer, in 2024, Industrial Production Statistics, National Accounts Statistics and data provided by relative associations are referred for weighting. ... ② As a reference for GDP and I/O Tables."

National accounts production-side estimates and industry breakdowns draw on industrial production statistics as a primary short-term and structural input. Evidence: "National Accounts statistics is compiled according to SNA, measured by supply(production), demand(expenditure) , and income approach to ensure data accuracy and reliability. ... National accounts statistics is compiled according to 2008SNA and the Statistical Classification of Industries (Rev.11)."

CBC monetary statistics sectoral classification of financial-institution transactions conforms to the United Nations System of National Accounts. Evidence: "The current methodology conforms to the United Nations “System of National Accounts,” and classifies the transactions of financial institutions into six sectors according to whether the counter party is a foreign entity, the government, a government enterprise, a private enterprise, an individual (household) or a domestic financial institution."
Industrial Production Index classification follows the Statistical Classification of Industries of the R.O.C. (aligned with ISIC). Evidence: "產品之歸類：根據經濟部統計處編印之工業產品分類共1,595項，將性質相同產品整併為723項產品群。"

DGBAS Manpower Survey (labour force / employment and unemployment statistics) employs the International Labour Organization’s standard definitions of employment and unemployment and recommended statistical methods. Evidence: "This survey, like similar surveys in many other countries, employs the International Labor Organization's standard definitions of employment and unemployment and recommended statistical methods."

CBC Financial Stability Report cites and uses DGBAS national accounts (GDP, economic growth) and CPI figures as key macroeconomic context indicators. Evidence: "Data cited from the DGBAS in this report, including Taiwan’s economic growth rate, GDP, and CPI figures, are based on its press release published on May 28, 2025. ... Sources: CBC and DGBAS."

CBC Financial Stability Report incorporates DGBAS CPI inflation data alongside GDP for macroeconomic assessment. Evidence: "Data cited from the DGBAS in this report, including Taiwan’s economic growth rate, GDP, and CPI figures, are based on its press release published on May 28, 2025."
